_comment: Copy this file to ~/.hermes/whatsapp/gatekeeper_config.json and fill in your own values. Nothing here should stay as a literal placeholder in a real deployment.
intro_message_template_example: Hi, this is {assistant_name} — {owner_name}'s assistant. {owner_name} can't get to messages right now, so I'm stepping in. You mentioned {topic} — want to work through that together?
_group_auto_reply_enabled_comment: false = the assistant never automatically replies in group chats (listen/log only). true = normal automatic replies in groups. Flip and save — takes effect immediately, no restart needed.
_remember_new_people_enabled_comment: false = the assistant never creates wiki profiles for unknown/new people encountered in group chats or added to the DM allowlist -- existing profiles are still enriched normally. true = when the assistant first sees an unmatched sender in a group (picked up by the nightly profile-sync job) OR when a new number is added to the DM allowlist that the assistant can already talk to, it automatically creates a minimal stub profile (bare facts only: name, phone, source, last message) in the wiki people folder -- no LLM call involved. Flip and save -- takes effect on the next nightly profile-sync run (not immediately, unlike group_auto_reply_enabled).
